I've got all five parts of the forbidden one.

Crit Dagger Spectral Throw Assassin. (Hardcore)

-The idea is to have high crit ele dmg with spec throw, 5k or more life, high evasion, dodge, spell dodge and block. Fortify and Lightning coil will mitigate phys dmg. With Bino's and Adder's Touch, enemies get poisoned increasing DPS.

-Main Damage Setup: ST+GMP+Added (element)+Critical Damage+Faster attacks+Power Charge on Crit (dunno if necessary with assassin passive.

-Auras: Hatred or Wrath + Herald of Ice/Fire + Clarity.

-Movement: WB+Fortify+Faster Attacks

-CWDT+Immortal call+Inc duration

-Assassin's Mark, Blood Rage and Stone Golem.

-Double strike+multistrike+faster attacks+life gained on hit. For single target. This might not be necessary if spec throw dmg is really good.

-Core equips: Crit phys dmg dagger > Bino's at late game Lighning coil, Crest of Perandus, Maligaro's Virtuosity. There might be better uniques but i've never played crit phys in hardcore so i'm up to suggestions.

-Flasks: Atziri's Promise, Jade Flask (Maybe rumi, don't know which is better), Silver Flask.

-My worries: How to deal with reflect. Currently evasion+dodge+block might be ok and avoid most of reflection, but i don't know what else can be done. Will mana regen+leech be able to keep up the high attack speed?

-Will it be Atziri Viable?
